projects.title: VCMI: Heroes of Might and Magic III mobile engine
projects.game: Heroes of Might and Magic III Complete Edition
projects.status: Android releases are listed for Google Play, F-Droid, and GitHub; the project also maintains an iOS build guide. Requires original Heroes III data files.

projects.title: fheroes2: Heroes of Might and Magic II Android port
projects.game: Heroes of Might and Magic II
projects.status: Android APK installation is documented; the repository was updated on 2026-10-15. Requires original or demo game data.
projects.summary: C++ recreation of the Heroes II engine with an Android build and asset-import instructions. The project does not include the commercial game files; its Android guide also documents use of demo data.

projects.title: Xash3D FWGS: GoldSrc-compatible mobile engine
projects.status: The maintainers' platform matrix lists Android and iOS as supported; Half-Life or compatible game data is required and is not included.
projects.summary: Open-source GoldSrc-compatible engine that runs Half-Life and compatible titles natively on Android and iOS. The project documents supported ports and mobile input; users supply game data.
projects.subtype: Multi-game Android and iOS engine port

projects.title: OpenMW Android: Morrowind mobile port
projects.status: Community-maintained Android/ChromeOS fork based on OpenMW 0.51; the README documents touch and controller support. Requires user-supplied Morrowind data; last repository push was 2026-10-13.
projects.summary: Mobile build of OpenMW, an open-source Morrowind engine reimplementation. This community fork adds Android/ChromeOS controls, launcher settings, and shader options; it does not include Bethesda's game data.
projects.strategy: OpenMW engine reimplementation and Android port

projects.title: Little Big Adventure 2 Classic Community mobile port
projects.status: Community-maintained source port with Android and Android TV packaging; v0.13.0 changelog and current build documentation are available. Players supply original game data.
projects.summary: Community-maintained C++ source port of the original Little Big Adventure 2 engine with Android builds. The project does not bundle the game's data files.

projects.title: Daggerfall Unity Android port
projects.status: Unofficial Android fork with APKs and setup instructions in Releases; last repository push was 2026-07-18. Requires Daggerfall game data.
projects.summary: Android fork of Daggerfall Unity, itself a Unity-based reimplementation of Daggerfall. The fork provides APKs and mobile setup guidance; players provide the original DOS game files.
projects.strategy: Unity engine reimplementation with Android port
